Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare, Bănci și Dezvoltare de software
Senior SDET | Playwright, C#/.Net, CI/CD | Global Payments & Banking Company Building Its Own QA Function 
Salary: RON 250,000 - 310,000 gross per year (RON 20,833 - 25,833 gross per month)
Location: Bucharest, hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 from home
Employment: via a local payroll partner until the company's Romanian entity is set up
 Our long-standing client, an international payments and banking group, is building its own QA function in Bucharest from scratch and is hiring Senior SDETs to help shape it. You'll join a team of around nine automation engineers, working alongside developers in two-week sprints.
 You'll report to the Head of QA, with a dotted line to the Bucharest site lead. You'll write Playwright automation across web apps, APIs, event-driven services and legacy Windows desktop apps, and help design the CI/CD pipelines it runs in. C#/.NET is their preference, though they'll consider strong Python or Java engineers too.
 Non-Negotiables 
SDET background, hands-on coding
Playwright
C#/.NET (Python or Java considered)
API testing: REST, contract, schema
End-to-end testing across integrated systems
CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
 What You'll Work With 
NUnit, with some TypeScript
Kafka and Azure Service Bus
Azure Application Insights, KQL
Kubernetes (K8s), Docker
IaC: Terraform
Web apps and legacy Windows desktop apps
GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry
TestRail, Jira
 Nice to Haves 
Financial services: payments, SWIFT, banking
Load testing at high transaction volumes: k6, Artillery, LoadRunner
MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors
AI in testing: test case generation, agentic workflows
Service virtualisation, mocks, stubs
BDD: Gherkin, SpecFlow
 Why Join / Projects 
 We've worked with this client for several years and placed people across their tech teams. This is one of the more interesting builds we're recruiting for in Bucharest.
You'll be one of the first in the team, helping set the standards as testing moves in-house from an outsourced provider.
You'll work across both sides of the business, payments and banking, rotating between projects rather than staying on one product.
Developers sync with you directly on their changes, so you're part of delivery from the start.
They're building a template for agentic engineering across the software lifecycle, with QA as one of its pillars, and you'll use AI in your day-to-day work.
The tech test is practical, and you can use Google and AI as you do on the job.
 Employee Benefits 
25 days' holiday plus Romanian public holidays
Extra day off in your birthday month
Private medical cover
Annual salary review
Support for training and study
Long service awards
 If you're a hands-on SDET who wants to help build a QA team from the start, apply and I'll give you a call.
 Senior SDET | Playwright, C#, CI/CD | Global Payments & Banking Company Building Its Own QA Function
